verdict.rationale: Mesh has its own permission model. There is an IAM roles API gated by a "View roles in account" permission, API credentials with configurable permissions, and named action permissions such as "Monitor and unmonitor customers", so actions are permission-gated by role. The evidence does not show how roles are defined or assigned to users, or that case investigation and decision actions specifically can be restricted. missing for 10: documentation of creating custom roles and assigning them to users, explicit permission controls over case and alert investigation and decision actions, the admin-action permission catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can restrict investigation and administrative actions to appropriate roles
